0 FILE production_scene.mpd
0 Name: Production Set with Minifig Family

0 // =========================================================
0 // SCENE LOGIC (TOP VIEW)
0 //
0 // - Location 1 (x ≈ -200, z ≈ -120..120): Front left entry set.
 
0 //   Goal: Primary entrance into the scene.
0 //   Obstacles: Narrow doorway + foreground crate.
0 //
0 // - Location 2 (x ≈ 200, z ≈ -120..120): Front right dock set.
0 //   Entity: Angled wall, dock floor, crate, bush.
0 //   Goal: Side loading / staging zone.
0 //   Obstacles: Offset floor and distance from family.
0 //
0 // - Location 3 (x ≈ -200, z ≈ 280..520): Upstage hero background.
0 //   Entity: Elevated roof window, Duplo-style window, tall tree.
0 //   Goal: Final “hero” background / destination.
0 //   Obstacles: Diagonal path around crates and trees.
0 //
0 // - Minifig Family:
0 //   Family Member 1 at z=0 (left side),
0 //   Family Member 2 at z=0 (right side),
0 //   Family Member 3 at z=160 (already moving upstage).
0 //
0 //   Scene Goal: Family crosses the production set from front (z≈0)
0 //               toward the hero background (Location 3, z≈400–520).
0 //   Shift: Empty set -> set dressed -> family arrives -> motion path.
0 // =========================================================


0 STEP
